summary: Customer runs a cell culture process in an aqueous medium; glucose and lactate are measured off-line from samples, and the delay makes it hard to see changes promptly. They are exploring an in situ spectroscopy pilot to be checked against the existing lab measurements. They state the medium and cell population change during the run, and that they have not yet selected a probe or a calibration strategy.
